==='''Towers of Midnight Book Tour, Barnes and Noble, New York, NY 8 November 2010'''===

'''''Report by lord Mordeth'''''




Hi everyone, it's been a while!

I was at this one too, asked Brandon as he signed my book who the old man in Natrin's Barrow in FoH was; he said he knew but wanted to check and that I should email him about it, so I'll do that tomorrow and hopefully he'll fill us all in once he gets back from France.

PS. The standard for trivia was pretty iffy; I appeared to be the only person in my part of the room who remembered what the BA cat lady's name was...
